sources.title: A Unified Framework to Elicit Structured Feedback
sources.snippet: Despite the improvements, current supervised approaches lack a unified framework that generates multi-trait feedback and scores jointly in a single autoregressive process. For instance, feedback is generated from an external LLM to augment inputs for training score-only model (Chu et al., 2025).
